desc:
Watch or control bot units in large-scale World War battles. Set up custom scenarios and experiment with armies featuring tanks, armored cars, ships, battleships, other vehicles, riflemen, officers, soldiers, mortarmen, and many more, see how the simulation plays out.

Performance & Development:
 Sandbox bot battle game made for fun by 1 person, still unfinished but updates ongoing.
 Expect bugs and lag due to bots (if you spawn in a lot) and large models. A good device is needed for this game.
 Changelogs and future plans are available in-game or in the community server.

Controls & Tips:
 Head to the map loader GUI to turn off map spawns/artillery.
 Type '/cmds' in chat for private server commands.
 Console support is still new thing to this game. Press "R2" to skip loading screens or continue.

Leave a like if you enjoyed! It gives me a lot of motivation to keep updating.

Credits:
 Fan game of Centaura.
 I do not own any models. The original creator gave permission to keep this up.
